Peer reviewers explicitly affirm the BBB damage data as 'solid' with multiple supporting experiments. Strong agreement on validity of TBI model.

Both evaluate AMP expression claims (C2, C50) as SUPPORTED. OpenEval highlights RT-qPCR temporal dynamics and consistency with prior reports. Peer reviewers accept immune response data as part of solid TBI characterization. Complete agreement on immune activation evidence.

Both evaluate astrocyte morphological changes (C3, C59-C66) as SUPPORTED. OpenEval emphasizes temporal specificity and comprehensive marker analysis. Peer reviewers affirm data on astrocyte responses and apoptosis as solid, though note some cellular aspects lost in revision. Agreement on core findings despite revision concerns.
